title: AP Promise Tracker Shows Trump Behind on Core 2024 Campaign Commitments
description_short: AP Promise Tracker Shows Trump Behind on Core 2024 Campaign Commitments
description_medium: The Associated Press promise tracker placed many of Donald Trump’s campaign commitments in unresolved, in-progress, or complicated categories rather than marking them complete. That challenged Trump’s claim that nearly all his promises had been delivered. The entry does not give the tracker’s date, total commitment count, or examples, so it cannot establish how many remained incomplete or which policies were assessed.
notes: Reason: The AP tracker page was inaccessible, and the supplied material has no tracker date, total, individual promise rows, or examples. Without those details, a full account of the reported delivery gap would repeat unverified generalizations.
Proposed correction: Add the tracker snapshot date, the promise count by status, the exact claim being compared, and several named commitments with AP’s status and explanation.

title: Trump Cost-of-Living Promise Undercut by Persistently Higher Core Household Prices
description_short: Trump Cost-of-Living Promise Undercut by Persistently Higher Core Household Prices
description_medium: At the end of Donald Trump’s first year in office, the listed prices for groceries, housing, electricity, and medical care remained above their levels at the start of his term, even as some categories had eased. Higher price levels and a slower inflation rate are different: slower increases do not mean prices have returned to an earlier level. The exact comparison requires the underlying indexes and dates.
notes: Reason: The linked PBS article concerns a campaign-promise tracker, not household prices. The PolitiFact price article was inaccessible, and the packet lacks the price series, comparison dates, and exact affordability statement needed for a sourced long account.
Proposed correction: Use the PolitiFact price report for the figures, identify each index and comparison date, state Trump’s exact claim, and distinguish price levels from inflation rates.

title: Trump Broad Deportation Promise for 'Criminal Migrants' Also Landed in 'Complicated' Bucket
description_short: Trump Broad Deportation Promise for 'Criminal Migrants' Also Landed in 'Complicated' Bucket
description_medium: The Associated Press tracker labeled Trump’s pledge to deport “criminal migrants” as “complicated,” rather than complete. The entry gives no exact wording of the pledge, the tracker’s definition of that status, or deportation figures tied to the promise. The label alone therefore does not show which parts had been implemented or what remained.
notes: Reason: The AP tracker and linked deportations report were inaccessible. The packet does not provide the pledge’s exact wording, AP’s criteria for “complicated,” or a documented implementation result, so a detailed explanation would require inference.

Proposed correction: Supply the tracker snapshot and status rationale, quote the specific promise, and add dated deportation or policy outcomes linked to that pledge. Remove claims that enforcement remained “maximal” or that legal pathways constrained it unless directly supported.

title: Trump’s Escalation Week Intensified Global Alert Cycles Around Energy and Shipping Risk
description_short: Trump’s Escalation Week Intensified Global Alert Cycles Around Energy and Shipping Risk
description_medium: On March 3, 2026, an Associated Press live report described the Iran conflict widening as U.S. and Israeli operations continued. A separate CNBC report from August covered later U.S.–Iran discussions over the Strait of Hormuz. The accounts concern distinct moments months apart and do not establish that one escalation week produced measurable shipping, energy-price, or allied-alert effects.
notes: Reason: The AP report is dated March 3, while the linked CNBC article is dated August 11 and concerns later Strait of Hormuz negotiations. The packet does not connect them into one escalation week or document shipping, energy-price, market, or allied-alert effects.
Proposed correction: Split the March conflict report and August Hormuz negotiations into separate events, or provide a dated source establishing the claimed sequence and measured impacts.

title: Trump Announced Major Iran Combat Operations in a Pre-Recorded Social Video
description_short: Trump Announced Major Iran Combat Operations in a Pre-Recorded Social Video
description_medium: Trump announced major combat operations against Iran in a prerecorded social-media video. The account identifies the format of the announcement but gives no operation name, time, immediate military details, or subsequent consequences. It supports describing how the announcement was delivered, but not broader claims that the format bypassed press scrutiny or changed the conduct of the war.
notes: Reason: The linked AP statement page was inaccessible. The packet identifies a prerecorded announcement but does not provide the operation’s name, the statement’s substantive details, or documented press-access consequences; the existing interpretation about unilateral narrative control is not established.

Proposed correction: Add the dated statement and operation details, identify the platform and publication time, and include a documented comparison with the administration’s press briefing or response if retaining a press-bypass claim.
